title: Cornell president says school "must do better" amid criticism of its investigation
description: Cornell's president said his school's administration "must do better" amid the criticism of its investigation into allegations made by a former student​ that she was gang-raped at a fraternity​ in 2024.

title: Michigan Urged to ‘Move Away’ From QB Bryce Underwood by Former College Coach
description: The Michigan Wolverines are urged to move off QB Bryce Underwood after their Week 4 loss to Minnesota by one former college coach.

title: Ex-US Attorney will lead independent review of Christa Pike botched execution
description: Gov. Bill Lee appointed former US Attorney Ed Stanton to review Tennessee's botched execution of Christa Pike.

title: Trump defiant about midterm chances as he rallies for Republicans in Ohio
description: US president tells a rally in Ohio that he believes there will be a 'big surprise' in the upcoming elections.

title: Saudi-backed Yemeni army says 700 Houthis killed in 24 hours
description: Yemen’s government forces claim to have killed hundreds of Houthi rebels as they attempt to retake lost territory.

title: Pick-up truck overturns trying to carry military chopper in Russia
description: An attempt by Russian stuntman Evgeny Chebotarev to carry an Mi-2 helicopter on a pickup truck went awfully wrong.
